title: Fever, a broken spear, and a lion charging | Folio 6 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
On that journey, near a place called Kikanan, Masud met a lion. And he was ill. He had what was called a quartan fever, a fever that comes back again and again, every few days, and leaves a man weak and shaking. He did not turn back. He went at the lion in his usual way. He threw his club. But the lion ducked, and the club flew over its head. So he took the charge on his spear, as he had done so many times before. The spear went into the lion's chest. But this time the fever had taken his strength. He could not hold it. The lion broke the spear and came straight at him. Stop for a moment and picture it. A sick young man, alone, his club gone, his spear in pieces, and a wounded lion on top of him. What did he do?

The full story: Folio 6: The Sultan and the Lion — on our channel and on every podcast app.
